heroHeadline: Madrid Residency Opens Tomorrow — 10-Night Run at Riyadh Air Metropolitano Largest in Spanish History; Adidas Flamboyan Also Drops May 30
heroSubtitle: Bad Bunny stands on the eve of the most ambitious single-city engagement of his career: a 10-night stadium residency at Riyadh Air Metropolitano in Madrid opening May 30, 2026 — the largest single-artist concert run ever staged in Spain, with 550,000+ projected attendees and €300M+ projected economic impact. The same day, the Bad Bunny x Adidas Ballerina 'Flamboyan' (KI7916, Vivid Red, $120) goes on wide global release via Adidas Confirmed. 'DtMF' approaches its 61st week at No. 1 on Billboard Hot Latin Songs (chart dated May 30) — the all-time record it first broke at week 57 by surpassing 'Despacito.' The DtMF World Tour has now completed stadium legs across Latin America, Asia-Pacific, and Europe (Barcelona, Lisbon), with the Madrid run spanning May 30–June 15 as the European closer. The *Porto Rico* epic film (directed by Residente, co-starring Viggo Mortensen, Edward Norton, and Javier Bardem) remains in pre-production with principal photography expected late 2026.
